caption: Actual Kindle screenshots of kherdr's native UI, displaying staged, privacy-safe demo content.
capture: Unedited Kindle X11 framebuffer captures, not desktop renders or photographs of the physical e-ink panel.
reproduction: Cross-build the kherdr-ui-preview target with the normal Kindle toolchain.
Run the preview on the Kindle with DISPLAY=:0 and either scene argument. It never loads user configuration or opens network sessions.
Use the normal launcher's bounded keep-awake and restoration lifecycle while preparing captures; do not leave sleep inhibition enabled permanently.
Wait for window-ready and inspect the actual display before capture.
The Machines screenshot can also be reached by tapping the navigator button in readme-hero.
privacy: All terminal text, tab labels, host identities, agent states, time and battery values are synthetic preview data. No private font files, personal device captures, credentials, or build-environment paths are included. Both PNGs contain only IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks.
